raw_segments.text: But he, the young chief of the Obergons, could ill-brook to be outdone in generous deeds,
but gave therefore with gracious gesture a testoon of costliest bronze.
Thereon embossed in excellent smithwork was seen the image of a queen of regal port, scion
of the House of Brunswick, Victoria her name, her most excellent majesty, by grace of God
of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, and of the British dominions beyond
the sea, queen, defender of the faith, empress of India.
